foto-01.prompt: Preserve this exact newspaper image and its existing rendering style, newsprint texture, pages, fold, photographs or illustrations and clean solid gray layout blocks. Shrink the ENTIRE newspaper to 78 percent of the canvas width, centered on a pure white square canvas, so there is at least 110 pixels of clear white margin on every side. Restore every complete paper corner and page edge; none may touch the canvas boundary. It must remain a folded large broadsheet NEWSPAPER made of thin grayish newsprint, not a bound book. Do not add any letters, numerals, masthead, logos, tiny text, scribbles, pseudo-writing or rows of marks. Preserve only the large solid gray rectangular column placeholders.

alt.ca: Diari de paper obert amb imatges de notícies i blocs grisos en lloc de text.
alt.es: Periódico de papel abierto con imágenes de noticias y bloques grises en lugar de texto.

foto-02.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: synthetic photorealistic studio photograph, natural believable materials, different real exemplar. One complete folded broadsheet newspaper lying at a slight diagonal, front page visible, with a small second folded section beside it. Clearly a DAILY NEWSPAPER: large thin matte grayish newsprint sheets, many visible folded pages at lower edge, a sober black-and-white front-page layout with one rectangular documentary photo of a city street and one smaller sports photo of a football. To obey the image vocabulary's no-writing rule, EVERY headline area and narrow article column is shown ONLY as simple solid pale gray rectangular layout BLOCKS. Absolutely NO actual text, NO letters, digits, words, pseudo-writing, scribbles, simulated tiny text lines, masthead or logos anywhere. Each column is a single clean flat light-gray rectangle, not rows of marks. The photos and folded newsprint distinguish it from a book or magazine. Entire newspaper fully inside canvas with at least 100 pixel white margin. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.

alt.es: Periódico de papel doblado con un suplemento al lado, fotografías y bloques grises sin escritura.
